Aspera Connect companion — phone install
========================================

Version: 0.3.7 (signed v1+v2+v3)

If Play Protect shows "App blocked" with only OK — use USB install:
  See INSTALL-PHONE-USB.txt

Direct download (may be blocked by Play Protect on some phones):
  https://github.com/ramchandragada/asperaconnect/raw/cursor/phone-contacts-sync-5b4f/dist/release/AsperaConnect-Phone.apk

USB (recommended for office phones):
  sudo apt install -y adb
  curl -L --http1.1 -o /tmp/AsperaConnect-Phone.apk \
    "https://github.com/ramchandragada/asperaconnect/raw/cursor/phone-contacts-sync-5b4f/dist/release/AsperaConnect-Phone.apk"
  adb install -r /tmp/AsperaConnect-Phone.apk

SHA256: 16c3c3ccd0a351410d50e2cb3ec19960b7ab458c1dbe2b6ee834e676177330b6
